mostWorthwhile.text: The load test was most worthwhile: measured draw, usable capacity and starting charge supported the overnight claim rather than relying on the solar panels.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two failed attempts to use the load meter felt repetitive, especially because the missing prerequisite was not initially apparent.

surprise.text: The link needed the solar charging pair installed before the load check, even though the panels would add no energy that night.

arbitrary.text: Making solar installation a prerequisite for measuring the already powered radios felt unclear; I could not infer that dependency from the goal.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the neighborhoods make their networks understand each other; Tin Row's call opens a concrete new problem after the satisfying clinic test.
